ImprovementTest.description: One planned improvement claim (a candidate and a metric), tested with Holm's step-down.

confirmed.description: rejected by Holm's procedure and in the better direction
confirmed.title: Confirmed

holm_threshold.description: family alpha / (planned tests - rank + 1) at this test's rank; None when untested. Tests ranked after the first one not rejected are never rejected
holm_threshold.title: Holm Threshold

p_value.description: two-sided paired t test; None when untested
p_value.title: P Value

t_statistic.description: paired t of the difference, signed so that positive means better; None when untested (no comparison, fewer than 2 seeds, a zero standard deviation, or a censored queue: lane full or vehicles held off the network at the entry)

PairedComparison.description: Candidate minus baseline for one metric, seed by seed.

sd_difference.description: sample standard deviation; None if n < 2
sd_difference.title: Sd Difference

shared_state_seeds.description: maximum queues only: seeds on which both runs reached their maximum before their signal programs first differed, so that seed's difference is zero by construction

verdict.description: improves or worsens only when the interval excludes zero; uninformative (rules 0.3.0) when the values measure a state both runs share, not the plan
